verdicts.reason: Diff line 17 uses `dollars > 50`, so a subtotal of exactly 5000 cents is charged shipping, contradicting 'Orders of $50 or more ship for free' in the PR description and README.
The added lines divide cents by 100 to get dollars and compare in dollars. AGENTS.md forbids converting to dollars in calculations. The constant is also in dollars.
AGENTS.md requires a boundary test for every pricing change. The only added test uses 6000, so the 4999, 5000 and 5001 boundaries are untested, which is why the >= bug goes unnoticed.
